hero.description: Business & research analyst with an International Economics degree from NEU (GPA 3.89/4.0). I write requirements documents, analyze data and present findings that decision-makers can act on.

about.title: About Me
about.paragraph1: I am an International Economics graduate from the National Economics University (GPA 3.89/4.0, Distinction). At Viettel's Quantum Center, I authored the market and customer analysis of a Market Requirements Document, co-authored the PRD and defended the project before 8 group-level functional boards until it was approved.
about.paragraph2: My research is in behavioral finance and econometrics. I led a 3-person student team studying how FOMO, loss aversion and herd behavior drive Vietnamese gold investors (500+ respondents, SEM); the paper was published in a Scopus Q2 journal in 2025. I have co-authored 8 papers in total.
about.paragraph3: I have also processed import-export document sets at MACS, collected enterprise data for the Hanoi Statistics Office and set up course data on an Odoo ERP system. I am looking for business analyst, research analyst and consulting roles where structured analysis drives real decisions.
